local P=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local done=workspace:GetAttribute('QADone') or '' local pref={"새 게임"} local skip={"삭제","초기화","나가기","종료","구매 확정","결제","Robux","로벅스"} local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize local function shown(d) local x=d while x and x~=P do if x:IsA('GuiObject') and not x.Visible then return false end if x:IsA('LayerCollector') and not x.Enabled then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==P end local function label(d) if d:IsA('TextButton') and d.Text~='' then return (d.Text:gsub('\n',' ')) end for _,c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do if c:IsA('TextLabel') and c.Text~='' then return c.Text end end return d.Name end local function keyOf(d) local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') local oy=sf and 0 or math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.Y/20) return label(d)..'@'..(sf and sf.Name or '')..math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.X/20)..','..(sf and (d.LayoutOrder or 0) or oy) end local best,bs=nil,-1 for _,d in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do if (d:IsA('TextButton') or d:IsA('ImageButton')) and d.AbsoluteSize.X>8 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>8 and shown(d) then local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') local inview=d.AbsolutePosition.X>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.X<vp.X and d.AbsolutePosition.Y>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y<vp.Y if inview or sf then local l=label(d) local key=keyOf(d) local bad=false for _,s in ipairs(skip) do if string.find(l,s,1,true) then bad=true end end if not bad and not string.find(done,key,1,true) then local sc=0 for i,p in ipairs(pref) do if string.find(l,p,1,true) then sc=100-i end end if sc>bs then bs=sc best=d end end end end end if not best then return 'NONE' end local sf=best:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('ScrollingFrame') if sf then local off=best.AbsolutePosition.Y-sf.AbsolutePosition.Y+sf.CanvasPosition.Y-(sf.AbsoluteSize.Y-best.AbsoluteSize.Y)/2 sf.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,off)) end return 'SCROLLED '..label(best)

local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local r=RS:WaitForChild('GameAction') local step,a='?',nil for i=1,14 do task.wait(1.5) a=r:InvokeServer('State',{}) step=(a and a.view and a.view.captain and a.view.captain.step) or '?' if step=='done' then break end end if step=='done' then return 'INTRO_OK' end local note='INTRO_STUCK step='..tostring(step) if step=='name' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroName',{name='QA선장'}) note=note..' name='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='companion' end if step=='companion' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroCompanion',{}) note=note..' comp='..tostring(x and x.ok) task.wait(0.3) step='portrait' end if step=='portrait' then local x=r:InvokeServer('IntroPortrait',{portrait='hero:england'}) note=note..' portrait='..tostring(x and x.ok) end task.wait(0.5) workspace:SetAttribute('DevCall','State') return note

local f=game:GetService('ServerStorage'):FindFirstChild('StudioQAInvoke') local pl=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local r=f:Invoke(pl,'QATacticsDump',{}) return 'TAC_DUMP '..tostring(r and r.message)

local p=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local out=nil local bestY=nil for _,d in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Text=="턴 종료" and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and (bestY==nil or d.AbsolutePosition.Y<bestY) then bestY=d.AbsolutePosition.Y out=string.format("%d,%d",math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.X+d.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.Y+d.AbsoluteSize.Y/2)) end end return out or "6,6"
local f=game:GetService('ServerStorage'):FindFirstChild('StudioQAInvoke') local pl=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local r=f:Invoke(pl,'QATacticsDump',{}) return 'TAC_DUMP '..tostring(r and r.message)

local p=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local g=p:FindFirstChild("TacticsView") local title="" if g then for _,d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("TextLabel") and string.find(d.Text,"턴") and title=="" then title=d.Text end end end local ok,hist=pcall(function() return game:GetService("LogService"):GetLogHistory() end) local errs,first=0,"" if ok then for _,m in ipairs(hist) do if m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageError then errs+=1 if first=="" then first=string.sub(m.message,1,200) end end end end return "TAC_END title="..title.." ERR n="..errs.." first="..first

for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then g.Enabled=false end end local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local VS=require(RS.Shared.VoyageScene) local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) local SR=require(RS.Shared.SeaRoutes) local PD=require(RS.Shared.Ports) task.spawn(function() local ok,err=pcall(VS.play,{shipId="galleon",steam=false,days=30,path=SR.path("lisbon","london",PD.Ports),fromName="Lisbon",toName="London",makeShip=PS.makeShip,place=PS.placeModel,escorts=2,weatherId="clear",event={kind="merchant"}}) workspace:SetAttribute("VoyageDone",tostring(ok)..tostring(err)) end) return "started"

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('VoyageScene') local c=workspace.CurrentCamera local sh=f.VoyageShip local vis,tot=0,0 local ex={} for _,d in sh:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('BasePart') then tot+=1 if d.Transparency<1 then vis+=1 end if #ex<4 then table.insert(ex,d.Name..':'..tostring(d.Transparency)..':'..tostring(d.Size)..':'..tostring(d.ClassName)) end end end local v,on=c:WorldToViewportPoint(sh:GetPivot().Position) local lt=game:GetService('Lighting') local at=lt:FindFirstChildOfClass('Atmosphere') local cc=lt:FindFirstChildOfClass('ColorCorrectionEffect') return 'stream='..tostring(workspace.StreamingEnabled)..' parts='..vis..'/'..tot..' ex='..table.concat(ex,';')..' vp='..tostring(v)..' on='..tostring(on)..' parent='..tostring(sh.Parent)..' fog='..lt.FogEnd..' brightness='..lt.Brightness..' atmo='..tostring(at and at.Density)..' camdist='..tostring((c.CFrame.Position-sh:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude)
return tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("VoyageDone"))

workspace:SetAttribute('VoyageActive', true) for _,g in ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA('ScreenGui') and g.Name~='BattleGui' then g.Enabled=false end end local ch=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character if ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then ch.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored=true end local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local NB=require(RS.Shared.NavalBattle) local ok,err=pcall(function() NB.play({shipId='galleon',shipName='갈레온',fleet={'플루트선','호위함'},weatherName='맑음',wind=1.0,windAngle=60,enemyName='검은 수염의 배',log={'[1] 우리 배: 포격! 적 선체 -12','[1] 검은 수염의 배: 포격! 선체 -8','[2] 우리 배: 포격! 적 선체 -15','[2] 검은 수염의 배: 포격! 선체 -6','[3] 우리 배: 포격! 적 선체 -30'},winner='a',reason='sunk',isBoss=false,onDone=function() end}) end) return 'play ok='..tostring(ok)..' '..tostring(err)

local out={} for _,m in ipairs(game:GetService('LogService'):GetLogHistory()) do if (m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageError or m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning) and #out<25 then out[#out+1]=string.sub(m.message,1,160) end end return 'LOGS('..#out..'): '..table.concat(out,' // ')
